summary.text: Routable (desk-verified against the PLATEAU 2023 survey geometry and official 2022/2026 maps; not field-verified; opening hours unknown): slice 1, the B1 Central Passage from the JR Central Gates east to Exits 27/34/35/36/37/42/43; slice 2, the passage along the JR east side to the South Passage east end and the south-east corridor to Exits 38/39/40/41; slice 3, the passage along the JR east side north to the North Passage (Exit 22, 東口（北）) and the passage between the Ikebukuro Shopping Park blocks to Exits 26/28/32/33; slice 4, the Central Passage west to the West Exit (西口) underground hall and its passages to Exits 10/11/15/17/18; slice 5, the South Passage west past the JR South Gate to the West Exit (South) hall (Exit 4, routed to the foot of its stairs, which are outside the survey) and the passage north to the West Exit hall. The rest of the PLATEAU B1 passage network is visible but not accessible (access unverified); access fences stop free walking there. Exits 4, 13 and 36 are routed only to the foot of their stairs; the stairs themselves are not part of the route. Fare-paid concourses and platforms are not modelled.

ルート案内対象（PLATEAU 2023年計測形状と公式案内図による机上検証。現地未確認、営業時間不明）：第1区画 中央通路（JR中央改札付近）から東側出口27・34・35・36・37・42・43；第2区画 JR東側通路から南通路東端、南東通路の出口38・39・40・41；第3区画 JR東側通路から北通路（出口22・東口（北））、池袋ショッピングパーク間の通路の出口26・28・32・33；第4区画 中央通路（西）から西口地下広場、出口10・11・15・17・18；第5区画 南通路（西）・JR南改札から西口（南）地下広場（出口4は計測範囲外の階段の下まで案内）、西口地下広場への通路。その他のB1地下通路は表示のみで立入不可（アクセス未確認のため、フェンスで進入を止めています）。出口4・13・36は階段の下までの案内で、階段自体はルートに含まれません。改札内・ホームは未モデル化。

gaps.missingFact: Opening hours of the B1 passages and each exit stair
gaps.fieldWorkNeeded: Official hours statement per exit, or dated on-site photographs of posted hours

gaps.zone: Central Passage, west and central parts
gaps.missingFact: Exact openings of the Marunouchi west/central/east gates and the Tobu central gates 1/2 in the PLATEAU geometry (two floor-level openings near the projected Marunouchi gates look like stairwells)
gaps.fieldWorkNeeded: On-site check of gate lines relative to columns; photos where permitted

gaps.zone: east hall to east corridor (z 27.8 -> 26.9) and all exits
gaps.missingFact: Step-free alternatives: elevators (EF_80 transport elements exist but their type, served levels and hours are unknown) and ramps
gaps.fieldWorkNeeded: Verify lifts/escalators near Exits 34/35 against the Tokyo Metro accessibility page and on site

gaps.missingFact: Geometry is from a 2023 survey; construction changes since then are unknown
gaps.fieldWorkNeeded: Dated walk-through comparing columns, exits and openings

gaps.zone: South Passage, south side between the JR South Gate and the West Exit (South) hall
gaps.missingFact: Which PLATEAU features are the Yurakucho Line South Passage East and West Gates: the gate machines on the official map sit inside surveyed floor with no gate-line opening, so their exact lines and the paid side are not established. Tokyo Metro's accessibility page does state a lift and escalator connection 南通路西改札～４番出入口（エソラ） (改札外), but it gives neither the gate's position nor the passage geometry, so 南通路西改札 is a search-only POI (metro-y-south-west-gate) and the link to Exit 4 is not an edge
gaps.fieldWorkNeeded: on-site check of both Yurakucho gate lines against column positions

gaps.zone: North-east, north of the Ikebukuro Shopping Park passage
gaps.missingFact: Exits 23, 24, 25, 29, 30 and 31: the official map shows two stairs (24, 25) where PLATEAU has one stair top, and 23/29/30/31 lie outside the surveyed geometry
gaps.fieldWorkNeeded: On-site check of which stair is 24 and which is 25; a survey source for the passage north of it

gaps.zone: West Exit area: Exits 8, 9, 14, 16, 19 and two unmatched stairwells
gaps.missingFact: PLATEAU models only the lower flights of Exit 9 and of two stairwells near (-181, 126) and (-165, 113) (to TP ~30 m, street ~33 m). Exit 9's flight lies ~9 m from its map position; the (-181, 126) flight sits beside the wide stair to the Fukutoshin Line West Passage, and the (-165, 113) flight runs into the Hope Center block towards Exit 7's map position, so neither is matched. Exit 8's stairs lie at the west end of the passage, ~12 m beyond the surveyed floor. Exits 14, 16 and 19 (西口（中央）) have no stair in the survey. (Exit 13's lower flight matches its map position and is routed to its foot.)
gaps.fieldWorkNeeded: a survey source for the upper flights and the passage west to Exit 8 (or a later PLATEAU release); on-site check of which stairwell is which exit

gaps.zone: Passage north from the West Exit (South) hall; Hope Center block
gaps.missingFact: Exits 5, 6a, 6b and 7: their stairs are outside the PLATEAU survey, and their feet cannot be matched one-to-one to PLATEAU openings (Exit 5 has two candidate openings 6 and 13 m from the map position, Exit 6b's nearest is 11 m away and raised; 6a and 7 lie inside the Hope Center block, whose interior is not surveyed)
gaps.fieldWorkNeeded: on-site note of where each exit stair leaves the passage, counted against column positions

gaps.zone: Passage along the west side of the JR block, between the South Passage and the Central Passage (west)
gaps.missingFact: Whether this surveyed passage is public (outside fare gates) or a JR-Tobu transfer concourse: the official map shows gate machines along its JR side and Tobu Central Gate 1 at its north end
gaps.fieldWorkNeeded: on-site check of both ends for gate lines and posted signage

assets.derivation: PLATEAU CityGML LOD4.1 -> pipeline/extract_plateau_ubld.py (ENU) -> pipeline/blender_build_glb.py (triangulated, metric UV0); renderer frame (x, z, -y), identity transform; collision comes from per-mesh gteki_role tags (floor/stairs_ramps walkable; wall/barriers/transport collide), not from the asset role, because verified exit routes pass through door and portal panels; runtime variant assets/ikebukuro_b1_lit.glb (listed in files, not a second asset, so loaders that load every asset never stack both): the same geometry + generated ceiling LED fixtures (GTEki art direction, not surveyed) -> pipeline/blender_bake_lighting.py: second UV set (TEXCOORD_1) and a Cycles diffuse lightmap (assets/ikebukuro_b1_lightmap.webp / _2k.webp, gamma-2.2 encoded, scale in ikebukuro_b1_lit.meta.json). scene/scene.ts loads the lit variant and falls back to this GLB

dataFiles.derivation: pipeline/build_signage.py: sign positions, facing and arrows from verified edge geometry and routing (gteki/graph.json); placement against PLATEAU ceiling and wall surfaces (build/ubld_enu.json); exit and gate names/labels from gteki/pois.json (names only, no source sign layout reproduced). sourceIds = every verified edge's geometry/access evidence and its end nodes' sourceRefs, plus the evidence of each exit and gate a sign shows (a wide set)

pipeline/build_station.py crowd_lanes(): per verified edge (gteki/graph.json geometry), the lateral width a pedestrian may stand off the polyline, sampled on the PLATEAU walkable grid (build/ubld_enu.json, >= 0.35 m from walls) inside the routable coverage areas (data/graph.src.json). sourceIds = PLATEAU, the routable areas' sources and every verified edge's geometry/access evidence and end nodes' sourceRefs (a wide set)

pipeline/build_walkfix.py: thin invisible quads bridging hairline cracks (< 0.30 m, same height within 0.06 m) between adjacent PLATEAU floor and stair-tread polygons (build/ubld_enu.json); they change neither the graph nor the rendered geometry

pipeline/build_access.py: fence pieces and 'access unverified' label stretches along the outline of the routable coverage areas (data/graph.src.json) where PLATEAU floor (build/ubld_enu.json) lies beside it; verified edge geometry (gteki/graph.json) is only checked for clearance and does not shape the output. sourceIds = PLATEAU and the routable areas' sources
